adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (packages/emails/email-manager.ts), the code maps over `calendarEvent.attendees` and branches on `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`. This is an O(attendees×newGuests) scan, and—more importantly for correctness—the handler calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw submitted `guests` array (see addGuests.handler.ts), not the filtered `uniqueGuests` that were actually inserted. As a result, if the submission includes existing attendees (or other non-inserted addresses like blacklisted ones), the branching can misclassify them and send the wrong email template. A precomputed `Set` of the truly inserted guests (e.g., `uniqueGuests`) would avoid both the performance and misclassification issues.
